description: 1. Agent must read SKILL.md to understand the memory-hub protocol. 2. Agent identifies ~/.openclaw/shared-memory/ as the working repo and config.json as the config (agent_id='agent-devops'). 3. Before writing, agent runs `git -C ~/.openclaw/shared-memory pull --rebase --quiet` and then `grep -r 'Helm' ~/.openclaw/shared-memory/ --include='*.md'` to check for duplicates. 4. Agent classifies the Helm lesson as KNOWLEDGE.md content (tool usage/best practice). 5. Agent appends a new entry to KNOWLEDGE.md using the EXACT proprietary format: `## [分类] 标题` header, 1-5 lines of content, and `_更新：YYYY-MM-DD by agent-devops_` footer. 6. Agent commits with the exact message format `🧠 [agent-devops] 更新 KNOWLEDGE.md: <description>` and pushes. 7. Agent runs the merge operation: pulls latest, distills ≤20 entries per file, overwrites SHARED_MEMORY_CACHE.md with all four sections covered. 8. Agent updates config.json's last_sync to current UTC timestamp. The traps: wrong format (no Chinese bracket notation, missing update footer, wrong agent_id), skipping dedup grep, adding unauthorized files, deleting original entries, or writing to wrong file (TOOLS.md instead of KNOWLEDGE.md).
